results.title: Sign-up accepts a 1-character password
results.expected: Sign-up rejects weak passwords (settings already requires >= 8 chars)
results.observed: POST /users with password "a" -> 201; PUT /user with password "b" -> 422 {"errors":{"password":["must be at least 8 characters long"]}}

password: must be at least 8 characters long

results.title: Sign-up accepts an invalid e-mail address
E-mail addresses are case-sensitive (login fails / duplicate accounts)
results.expected: Login with the same address in lower case succeeds; registering it again is rejected (409)
results.observed: register Case.User_d18aad@Example.test -> 201; login as case.user_d18aad@example.test -> 401 {"errors":{"credentials":["invalid"]}}; register case.user_d18aad@example.test again -> 201

results.title: Usernames may contain URL-reserved characters (?, /, #, space)
results.expected: Username restricted to URL-safe characters (or always URL-encoded by clients)
results.observed: "qa?tester_d18aad": register 201, GET unencoded 404, GET encoded 404 | "qa/tester_d18aad": register 201, GET unencoded 405, GET encoded 404 | "qa#tester_d18aad": register 201, GET unencoded 404, GET encoded 200 | "qa tester_d18aad": register 201, GET unencoded 200, GET encoded 200

results.title: No rate limiting / lockout on failed logins
results.expected: After a handful of failures the API throttles (429) or locks the account temporarily
results.observed: 30 wrong passwords in 3.7s -> status counts {"401":30}; correct password afterwards -> 200

results.title: Logout does not invalidate the session token (60-day JWT, silently renewable)
results.expected: Logout revokes the token server-side; tokens are short-lived
results.observed: token lifetime = 60 days; GET /user with the "logged-out" token -> 200; response contains a NEW token = true (expires 2026-11-28T17:03:47.000Z)

results.title: Editing an article (even only its body) changes its URL; old links return 404
results.expected: Slug stays the same when the title is unchanged; old URLs keep working (or redirect)
results.observed: created slug "Slug-stability-d18aad-f933522b"; after body-only edit slug = "Slug-stability-d18aad-1b3ed2ea"; GET old slug -> 404 {"errors":{"article":["not found"]}}

results.title: Duplicate tag in one article -> misleading error
results.expected: Duplicates silently de-duplicated (or a clear "duplicate tag" message)

results.title: Tags are not trimmed (" qa " and "qa" become different tags)
results.observed: POST /articles with tagList ["  paddedd18aad  ","paddedd18aad"] -> 201, saved tagList = ["  paddedd18aad  ","paddedd18aad"]

results.title: No length limits: a 30000-character title creates an article that can never be opened
results.expected: Title length validated (e.g. <= 200 chars) so every saved article is reachable

results.title: No request-size limit (10 MB article body accepted)
results.expected: Request rejected with 413 above a sane limit (e.g. 1 MB)

results.title: HTML/JS in markdown body is stored verbatim (UI must sanitise it)
results.expected: Stored as-is is acceptable only if every client sanitises on render
results.observed: POST article with /

results.title: Other users cannot edit/delete my article or my comment (authorization)
results.expected: 403 for PUT/DELETE by another user; content unchanged
results.observed: PUT by another user -> 403; DELETE article -> 403; DELETE comment -> 403; article afterwards -> 200, body "original"

results.title: Page size (limit) has no upper bound
results.expected: limit capped (e.g. max 100) so one request cannot pull the whole table
results.observed: limit=100000 -> 200, returned 19 of 19 articles in one response (default page = 10)
